d: Jet black hair is extremely long, flowing down past the knees, with straight bangs covering the eyes. The face appears as a mature young adult, though the eyes are obscured by a white blindfold. The build is slender and lithe, dressed in a white short-sleeved dress with a high collar, paired with white thigh-high buckled boots, black stockings, and black leather leg straps. Signature details include two white feathered wings with purple tips and silver nails driven through them, connected by heavy silver chains that bind the arms, and three glowing cyan butterflies floating around the head and shoulders.
